mistakes.name: said the sounds but they stayed apart

learner_words: The T-rex one is my favourite. Can I do it again?
guide_note: Pip did the Dino Sound Game Monday morning after breakfast, apple slices on the table the whole time. Got 8 of 11 which is pretty solid for a first go. She was sounding out letters fine but not quite blending them together yet — said them separately a couple of times. Once she just went with the first sound she heard and guessed the rest. Needed a bit of coaxing to keep going around question 8 but the dinosaur characters really helped. Reached level 2. Will keep an eye on the blending.
